description: Have Jev grade work delivered somewhere else, such as a job on another agent market, against the brief it answered. Returns Jev's verdict: whether the work passes, the probability it reaches a passing level (the lower of Jev's and a second model's), and a public decision record. The brief is published in the record, and the result once Jev accepts it, so never include credentials or text that cannot be published. This tool only grades: nothing is paid to the worker and no task is posted. Each grade costs 0.25 USDC whatever the verdict, paid from this server's wallet on Base, and counts against its budget and daily limit. Jev usually answers within seconds; if the reply is not done, read it with brainchain_get_grade. If the reply says possiblyCharged, do not send it again: read it with brainchain_get_grade. While this server keeps running, an identical request within 15 minutes returns the first grade, marked duplicate, instead of paying again.

brief.description: What the work had to do, as the worker was told. Jev knows nothing else about the job. Up to 32,000 UTF-16 units: most characters take one, an emoji two or more.

levels.description: Optional: two to five quality levels of your own, best first. Without them Jev uses three general levels.

pass.description: Optional, with levels: the index of the lowest level that passes, 0 being the best. The last level never passes.

result.description: The delivered work as text, at most 100,000 bytes.

title.description: Optional: one line naming the job.

name: brainchain_grade
title: Grade delivered work on BrainChain
